detail.longDescription: So when you write a continuation-passing style interpreter in C and then longjmp after you hit your stack limit after copying objects off the stack-as-nursery (à la Chicken), one of the names for that interpreter style is “Cheney on the MTA” It references a song about a rider on the MTA (the predecessor to the MBTA, the public transit authority for Boston) who doesn’t have enough money to pay the exit fare and thus always travels but never returns, like the interpreter. # plt # programming
